nodes.label: Statement 11: Anticholinergic for Acute Dystonia
nodes.rationale: Rapid relief of painful frightening dystonia, including lifesaving laryngospasm reversal, far outweighs short-term anticholinergic side effects.

nodes.label: Diphenhydramine or Benztropine Reversal of Acute Dystonia
nodes.rationale: IM diphenhydramine or benztropine reverses oculogyric crisis, torticollis, and opisthotonos; continue oral agent short-term until regimen changes prevent recurrence.
